BiblicalUsage: The word means in Aramaic, the language of Syria. Hezekiah's officers ask the Rabshakeh to speak to them in the Syrian language so the people on the wall will not understand, and the Chaldeans answer Nebuchadnezzar in Syriac.
TheologicalSignificance: The language of the enemy's court and the language of the common people are not the same, and the officers knew which one to ask for.
